note: Real vectors are unmodified files from the reference client's examples directory. The invalid/ files are renamed with the .ots names kept; sha1-a-or-b.ots and sha1-a come from examples/sha1/. bitcoin_header_358391.note: 80-byte header of block 358391, fetched from an Esplora explorer (https://blockstream.info/api/block/<hash>/header). It is self-authenticating: it hashes to the block id the explorer named and meets its own nBits target; both are asserted by tests.
